title: ‘The Love Hypothesis’ Trailer: Lili Reinhart and Tom Bateman Embark on Fake Dating Scheme in STEM Romance
description: Adapted from Ali Hazelwood’s bestselling novel, Reinhart and Bateman star as a Ph.D. candidate and the school’s intimidating professor pretending to be in a relationship.

title: Barry Keoghan to Lead and Produce ‘Top Boy’ Prequel Series ‘Jonny Boy’ at Netflix (Exclusive)
description: Creator-writer of the original show Ronan Bennett is returning for 'Jonny Boy,' as is Canadian rapper Drake, who executive produced the British BAFTA-winning crime drama.

title: DAZN Buys EverPass Media in Commercial Sports Rights Push
description: EverPass investors the NFL, TKO and RedBird will become minority shareholders in DAZN, which is making a major move into the commercial side of sports media.

title: Jaye P. Morgan, Singer and Bawdy ‘Gong Show’ Panelist, Dies at 94
description: A lover of double entendres, she got fired from the Chuck Barris game show after showing her breasts during a Mean Gene Dancing Machine routine.

title: Disney+ Greenlights Wedding Planner Rom-Com Drama From Playwright Kate Cortesi
description: The six-part series will follow Maddy Caruso, a British wedding planner for an eclectic list of clients in the Italian countryside, whose chaotic love life comes back to bite her.

title: Andrew Garfield’s ‘The Uprising’ Confuses Fans After Reveal as Robin Hood Origin Story
description: Just two weeks before its release, Focus Features is now marketing Paul Greengrass' film — set during the 1381 English Peasants' Revolt — as 'The Uprising: The Rise of Robin Hood.'

title: Roku Lands NWSL Matches in Latest Sports Rights Deal (Exclusive)
description: The deal covers more than 30 games in the remainder of this season and in 2027.

title: Iranian Drama ‘A Bit of Light’ Sells Wide Ahead of Venice Premiere (Exclusive)
description: In Ali Asgari's drama, 'The Seed of the Sacred Fig' star Misagh Zareh plays a doctor who loses faith in the future after being arrested by the Iranian regime and having his medical practice shut down.
